title: Jaire Alexander reportedly paid back Eagles $889K after never playing for a Philly team that traded for him

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jaire Alexander reportedly paid back Eagles $889K after never playing for a Philly team that traded for him
sources.description: Alexander stepped away from football last November, less than two weeks following a low-risk trade the Eagles made to bring the former All-Pro CB to Philadelphia.
